facts.fact: Molly 一早敲门盛赞 Jessica 的书稿，夸感情写得真实
facts.anchor: It felt so lived-in. It was like you really knew what it was like to be in love!

facts.fact: Molly 把书中恋人与她们类比后，Jessica 心跳漏拍、装作冷静
facts.anchor: Jessica’s heart skipped a beat, but she needed to play it cool.

facts.fact: 农场主 Rowan 出场外貌：酒浸红鼻、白胡茬、鸭舌帽
facts.anchor: The family patriarch, Rowan Downythistle, was a thickset man with a red gin-soaked nose, a day’s worth of whiskers on his cheeks, and a fringe of white hair poking out from under his flatcap.

facts.fact: 儿子们为 Tigglestide 庆典把一个兄弟缝进巨熊装
facts.anchor: Rowan led them behind the barn, where several more sons were sewing one of their number into a massive bear suit.

facts.fact: 羔羊泪眼特写：凸眼水汪汪、长睫毛不停滴泪
facts.anchor: The lambs had enormous, goggling eyes, so dewy that tears continuously dripped from their long, long lashes.

facts.fact: 少女顶撞父亲后坚称自己的名字是 George
facts.anchor: No one calls me Georgette! Everyone calls me George!

facts.fact: Lady Tuppence 出场形象：棉花糖蓝高发髻、镶钻猫眼镜
facts.anchor: She was an older woman with a tower of cotton candy–blue hair on her head, a pair of bedazzled cat-eye spectacles perched on her beaky nose

facts.fact: 面对不祥的树干兔脸，Jessica 出口只有一句好可爱
facts.anchor: But out loud, she only said “How cute!” as they continued on their way.
